description.en: Plays an NPC's talk motion (the motion name stored in the NPC's data), with the given mode and a 30-frame transition (see CMND_SET_MOTION).
Play mode (the NPC talk script passes true, i.e. 1).
Always null (also when the NPC or its motion is not found).

examples.case: After the turn to face the player (real usage, from ev43010000.nut)
